name: AerialYield-T2M
description: AerialYield-T2M is a real-image dataset of 677 RGB greenhouse tomato frames from two complementary acquisition sources: 535 close-range video frames and 142 drone video frames, collected in a commercial indoor greenhouse at Silal IO, UAE. The source COCO annotations contain 14,303 tomato instances across six ripeness stages (Green, Breakers, Turning, Pink, Light Red, Red), following the Silal Quality Standard Guide for Tomato. The release provides class-specific binary masks, semantic label maps, overall-fruit masks, polygons, bounding boxes, classification crops, image-level visible-fruit counts, modality metadata, SHA-256 checksums, a deterministic block-grouped train/validation/test split, and COCO/YOLO detection exports. Full technical validation (completeness checks, mask/annotation audits, split-integrity analysis, image-quality screening) and reference baselines for classification, segmentation, counting and detection are described in the accompanying Data Descriptor manuscript.
